title: SuperCreativity #375 (James Taylor) — Eric: 'I've taken the most boring topics imaginable and tried to make them' the most exciting things in the world
summary: James Taylor — keynote speaker on creativity/AI, host of the SuperCreativity Podcast — brings Eric back for episode 375 to frame governance as a creative discipline, not a compliance one, and to argue that the boldest move on most boards is to look slightly different from everyone else.
